title.narrative: Provision of essential assistance for children affected by Cyclone Mocha in Chin and Sagaing region

description.narrative: ltpgtThe project will provide the essential education materials to the children affected by Cyclone Mocha in the conflict affected areas in Chin and Magway regions. The activity will be directly implemented by KMSS. Implementation will take placed in 64 IDP camps and host communities with education interventions targeting areas of greatest needs, reaching a total of 16,439 individuals (4023 IDPs and 11628 Host). The target areas are all profoundly affected by Cyclone Mocha and ongoing humanitarian crisis in Chin and Magway, with the majority of children living in the displacement sites. This project aims to contribute to the reduction of the immediate suffering of children in these target areas by responding the immediate action for post-emergency restoration of education and learning for children in affected townships of Chin and Magway, in coordination with other actors in Chin and Magway, in alignment with the priority of this allocation as well as coordinating with other ongoing education projects funded by MHF and other funding agencies. The townships targeted for this response are Matupi ( 19 communities), Mindat (15 community ), Hakha ( 15 communities ) in Chin and Tilin (5 communities), Gangaw (10 communities ) in Magway.ltbrgtA conflict-sensitive approach will be followed towards the inclusion of vulnerable children and people in all project sites. Specific vulnerable groups such as children with disabilities, children special needs will be prioritized to ensure their needs and concerns are appropriately addressed. The project will consider female’s specific needs. Gender balanced staff will be recruited where possible, women and girls will be separately engaged in consultations/training/meeting and gender disaggregated data will be collected. AAP, inclusion and protection, prevention of GBV/SEA, environmental risks, localization and social cohesion will be mainstreamed throughout.ltbrgtKMSS has pre-selected, sustained access to communities and are well positioned to implement this project due to our combined sectoral experience and longstanding presence in the target locations. KMSS is currently implementing humanitarian and development programs in Northwest region with staff based in the communities, giving KMSS unique access to the situation within the communities in Chin and Magway.ltbrgtThe project will be achieved through the following education activitiesltbrgt1) Renovation of learning/ school renovation ltbrgt2) Provision of learning materialsltbrgt3) Distribution of student kits/ ltbrgt4) Recruitment of volunteer teachers and trainingsltbrgtlt/pgt
